messages:
elaine_sales: Hey team — customer PineBridge wants to run a 72-hour POC next week and asked for a short-term QPS bump on their hosted API key. Can we do a scoped increase for the window? :pray:

devon_se: Do we have the baseline for their current key? What qps are they at today?

elaine_sales: They're on a demo key now, averaging 8 rps but spike tests will hit ~120 rps for 10s bursts, sustained ~30 rps during daytime. Token sizes ~350 tokens/gen. POC window: Tue 2026-04-06 08:00 -> Thu 2026-04-08 20:00 (UTC).

marco_infra: We can do a temporary soft bump if it's hosted. Need the exact key id and whether we should scope by IP or keep it tenant-wide. Also need billing approval for overage.

elaine_sales: Key id: rk_live_pine-01 (scoped). Customer prefers scoped key per environment — keep it isolated. We'll cover overage in the PO. Can we set an automatic revert at end time?

sri_reliability: Yes, we can schedule a rate-limit change and auto-revert. Suggest lifecycle: 1) preview window to validate traffic (1h), 2) full bump, 3) revert + postmortem. What target numbers?

elaine_sales: Target sustained QPS 40, peak bursts 140 for <=30s, concurrent requests ~40. If we hit capacity fallback, want clear 429 behavior and headers.

devon_se: Ok. For hosted keys we manage quota by token/sec and req/sec. We'll map 40 qps -> tokens/sec approx 14k tok/s. Pricing note: estimated extra cost ~ $600 for 72h at current unit rates, confirm finance.

arjun_support: FYI, I need to add this to the POC tracker and create a scoped key if ops asks. Also need the contact at PineBridge for troubleshooting (they want an SRE on-call).

elaine_sales: Contact is sara@pinebridge.com and their engineer is matthew_p. I'll add to tracker.

marco_infra: I'll provision a temporary rate plan: request_limit=200req/s, sustained_target=40qps, token_budget=18000tok/s, expires=2026-04-08T20:00:00Z. We'll enable detailed rate-limit headers: `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset`.

ops_bot: deploy-bot: rate-plan-create rk_live_pine-01 -> {plan: "poc-temporary-1779995555", limit: 200, tokens_per_sec: 18000, expires: 2026-04-08T20:00:00Z} succeeded 

sri_reliability: I'll add a canary rule: first hour only 20% traffic to bumped plan, if error rate >3% rollback automatically. Also adding alert on 5xx and sustained 429s.

devon_se: Two operational notes: 1) provide them a scoped key that forbids embeddings (they only need generation) to reduce abuse, 2) show them how to check rate headers in curl: 
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer rk_live_pine-01" 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

elaine_sales: Perfect. Any compliance/security blockers for hosted key in a POC? They asked about data retention.

sri_reliability: For hosted POCs we retain logs for 30 days by default. We can enable longer retention at request and create an incident audit log export if they need. No additional contract needed for a short bump. For production they'd want Dedicated or Private.

arjun_support: Added notes to POC tracker and assigned on-call matthew_p for the window.

elaine_sales: Thanks all — please confirm when the scoped key and plan are live and I'll hand it to PineBridge with the curl snippet. :thumbsup:

marco_infra: Done. Scoped key `rk_pine_poc_temp` created and plan `poc-temporary-1779995555` attached. Expires as scheduled.

ops_bot: notify: scheduled-revert for plan poc-temporary-1779995555 set for 2026-04-08T20:00:00Z

elaine_sales: Awesome, closing loop. I'll send a pre-test at T-24h and the spike test report after.

devon_se: If they need >200req/s we should move to Dedicated POC baseline instead of hosted. Will call out in follow-up.

elaine_sales: Noted. Thanks everyone.
